loading.note: eager in the header, which is above the fold on every page, so lazy loading would delay it and the largest contentful paint with it; lazy in the footer. Eager, not fetchpriority=high: that is the one priority image's (section#priority-media), and loading="eager" is what both platforms can write, where next/image cannot omit the attribute without claiming priority (SC-019).
